reason: The cited evidence (E1/E2) concerns Al-Cr-Co-Fe-Ni alloys, not the Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni system, and only shows that SRO and clustering occur in one Al-containing HEA; it does not demonstrate that SRO varies with constituent count in the target alloy family, nor that SRO governs mechanical properties. The key premises linking SRO to mechanical behavior in Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
